messages:
Pam: forwarding ticket from AcmeCorp — customer sees a 400 when calling a tool. says error: "Tool args JSON parse error: trailing comma at position 213". pasted curl below, I removed PII.

Customer-Rep: thanks, here is the exact curl we used (redacted):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ****" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{\n    "model": "gpt-annotate-1",\n    "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"annotate this file"}],\n    "functions": [{"name":"annotate_file","parameters":{\n      "type":"object",\n      "properties": {"filepath":{"type":"string"},"note":{"type":"string"}},\n      "required": ["filepath"]\n    }}],\n    "tool_call": {\n      "name": "annotate_file",\n      "arguments": {\n        "filepath": "C:\\Users\\bob\\Documents\\report.docx",\n        "note": "please mark sections A and C",\n      }\n    }\n  }'\n```

Josh: looks like the payload sent tool_call.arguments as raw JSON object in the request body. The snippet has a trailing comma after "note": ... , which will break a strict JSON parser. Can you confirm the customer is not accidentally templating this and adding the comma?

Customer-Rep: they say the payload is generated by their internal template engine on Windows. they pasted the string exactly as sent. they also noted some clients on Windows produce a trailing \r\n and sometimes templates append commas.

Dev Support Bot: [log] request_id=rcq-42f7 request_time=2026-02-15T18:12:07Z status=400 error=InvalidToolArguments message=JSON parse error at position 213 path=tool_call.arguments

Siva: thanks for the repro. quick notes from runtime: our function-calling layer expects the functions[].parameters to be a JSON schema and tool_call.arguments to be a JSON object (or a string that parses to one). If the client sends malformed JSON (trailing comma) the request will be rejected with 400. We intentionally don't do lenient parsing here to avoid subtle security/semantic issues.

Sophie: for customer unblock, ask them to either: 1) ensure their templating engine emits valid JSON (remove trailing comma), or 2) wrap the arguments as a JSON string (i.e. send "arguments": "{\"filepath\":\"C:\\\\Users\\bob\\\\Documents\\report.docx\",\"note\":\"please mark sections A and C\"}"" ) — then server will do a second parse step and we can add better errors.

Josh: can you repro locally with the curl above and confirm error message? Also want to capture full request_id.

Pam: repro done, confirmed server returns 400 and logs same parse error. stack frame points to argument parsing in function-calling middleware. sending request_id rcq-42f7 to customer so they can match logs.

Siva: root cause summary: client's templating on Windows produced an extra trailing comma in the arguments object. That is strictly invalid JSON. Workarounds: sanitize template, or use a JSON serializer in their client code. Long term we could consider accepting trailing commas behind a feature flag for Hosted, but that opens path to inconsistent behavior between Hosted and Private deployments.

Customer-Rep: customer asked whether Redwood could accept more tolerant JSON. they'd prefer a quick fix on our side if possible.

Siva: short-term we can offer them a patch in their integration: example Python fix:
```py
import json
args = {"filepath": r"C:\\Users\\bob\\Documents\\report.docx", "note":"please mark sections A and C"}
payload = {"model":"gpt-annotate-1", "messages":[{"role":"user","content":"annotate this file"}], "functions": [...], "tool_call": {"name":"annotate_file","arguments": args}}
body = json.dumps(payload)
# send body as application/json
```

Josh: I'll add a short KB article and a sample curl/python snippet. Pam — can you send the customer the request_id and the suggested quick fix? Also flag for sales if they need a lower-friction workaround.

Pam: sent request_id and python snippet. customer replied they can patch quickly. marking as resolved for now but leaving thread open in case they ask for us to relax parsing.

Siva: opened internal ticket ENG-RUNTIME-829 to discuss permissive parsing behind a feature flag. will include risk assessment and test matrix (Hosted vs Private).

Pam: closing loop — customer confirmed fix worked after removing trailing comma. closing ticket. :white_check_mark:
